scripts.build:bump:pro: node scripts/version-bumper.js prod && vite build --mode production
scripts.build:bump:dev: node scripts/version-bumper.js dev && vite build --mode development
scripts.mobile:build:bump:prod: node scripts/mobile-version-bumper.js prod && vite build --config vite.config.mobile.js --mode production
scripts.mobile:build:bump:dev: node scripts/mobile-version-bumper.js dev && vite build --config vite.config.mobile.js --mode development
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run mobile:build
scripts.build:all:dev: npm run build:dev && npm run mobile:build:dev
scripts.build:all:bump:prod: npm run build:bump:pro && npm run mobile:build:bump:prod
scripts.build:all:bump:dev: npm run build:bump:dev && npm run mobile:build:bump:dev
